name: 46112 · Brownsburg, IN
findings: ZIP 46112 (Brownsburg) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46112 (Brownsburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
